studio.name: Kaelen Voss, AIA
studio.tagline: Sculpting light, sustainable materiality, and timeless spatial geometries.
studio.bio: Kaelen Voss is an internationally recognized architect specializing in sustainable residential sanctuaries, civic pavilions, and adaptive mass-timber renovations. With a philosophy rooted in Nordic restraint and passive solar thermodynamics, Studio Arcos creates buildings that age with dignity.

projects.title: The Alpine Monolith
projects.desc: Submerged partially into the hillside to leverage natural geothermal thermal mass and minimize visual landscape intrusion.

projects.title: Fjord Cultural Pavilion
projects.desc: Cantilevered mass-timber event hall providing uninterrupted panoramic fjord vistas with passive cross-ventilation.

projects.title: Koppar Atrium Lofts
projects.desc: Conversion of a historic locomotive repair hall into 14 biophilic loft residences wrapped around a daylighting atrium.

awards: 2022 Mies Crown Hall Americas Prize (MCHAP) Finalist
